subject: Acme workshop: concierge itinerary, presenter packet gating, and final pre-read lock
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood-inference.com>
To: Michelle Torres <michelle@acmecorp.com>, Acme Event Ops <events@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood-inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acme workshop: concierge itinerary, presenter packet gating, and final pre-read lock

Hi Michelle / Acme events team —

Thanks again for confirming the room and headcount. We put together a first-pass concierge itinerary and a presenter packet gating checklist to make sure nothing gets missed the week of the onsite (attached: Acme_Workshop_Pre-read_v2.pdf). Main asks from our side:

- Can you confirm final attendee arrival windows (AM/PM) for the 32 invitees by EOD Tuesday? We need arrival times for shuttle assignments.
- Please confirm whether any attendees require security escort or special access (list or badge type).
- AV: LumenAV will run the room, but we need a contact and any hard stops for staging. Michelle — can you share the on-site AV lead and their preferred contact number?

Internal note: Kimberly / Vanessa — the presenter packet needs the "final slide deck (PDF)" locked by Tue 5pm PT so we can generate printed booklets and an attendee one-pager. If slides are later, we'll move to digital-only and reduce printed sets.

I'm attaching a short logistics checklist and the current pre-read. I propose the following timeline:
- Tue 5pm PT: final slide PDF to Redwood ops
- Wed morning: print proof and badge roster finalization
- Thu noon: shipment to venue concierge / greenroom drop-off

Michelle — would you prefer the printed booklets on each chair or a single welcome table distribution?

Thanks,
Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Events Program Manager, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood-inference.com

From: Michelle Torres <michelle@acmecorp.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Acme Event Ops <events@acmecorp.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme workshop: concierge itinerary, presenter packet gating, and final pre-read lock

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the checklist — this is helpful. A few updates from our side:

1) Arrival windows: We have two wave options. 18 folks arrive AM (between 7:30–9:00), 14 arrive PM (between 13:00–15:00). I'll export a per-person arrival column and send by EOD (will attach to events@acmecorp.com).

2) Badges / escorts: Two executives require escorted building access (Anya Rosales, David Chu). Please flag them for security.

3) LumenAV contact: Alex Ruiz (alex@lumenav.com, +1-415-555-0123). He confirmed the room rig and asked whether we will require a dedicated confidence monitor per presenter — if so, he needs slide PDFs 24 hours ahead of first use.

4) Printed distribution: Acme prefers booklets on each chair for executives and a single welcome-table set for general attendees (we'll mark VIP chairs). If Redwood can provide 10 VIP printed booklets and 22 general boxed sets, that would align with our budget.

I'll attach the arrival roster once HR finalizes travel.

Best,
Michelle

Michelle Torres
Head of Events, Acme Corp
michelle@acmecorp.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood-inference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood-inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Aug 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme workshop: concierge itinerary, presenter packet gating, and final pre-read lock

Looping in Mateo for ground transport and final asset handoff. A couple of operational clarifications:

- Slide deadline confirmation: we can accept final PDFs until Tue 5pm PT, but any changes after Tue 2pm will not make the printed proof. Please name files as: ACME_Deck_Lastname_TEAM.pdf.
- Printed counts: We'll print 10 VIP booklets + 22 general. Vanessa — can you confirm printer pickup window (Wed 9–11am) so Mateo can schedule courier?
- AV / confidence monitors: We will provide two confidence monitors (front-stage left/right) but Alex at LumenAV has to patch them. Mateo — please confirm that LumenAV will receive local content drop by Thu 8am for last-minute checks.
- Materials in packet: agenda (1), executive one-pager (1), presenter bios (4), printed feedback forms (30) — see attached Ground_Transport_Roster.xlsx for routing schedule.

Also attaching the AV SLA we have with LumenAV (AV_SLA_LumenAV.pdf). Michelle — the SLA notes that if we request additional engineer hours beyond the 8 included, we'll route to LumenAV for approval and billing.

If everything above looks good I'll lock the final presenter list and send calendar updates for rehearsal slots (Wed 3–5pm).

Thanks —
Kimberly

Kimberly Park
Head, Event Operations, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood-inference.com

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood-inference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood-inference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood-inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com>, Acme Event Ops <events@acmecorp.com>

Subject: Re: Acme workshop: concierge itinerary, presenter packet gating, and final pre-read lock

Thanks team — quick confirmations from logistics:

- Courier booked: Wed pickup at 10:00am (will deliver to venue concierge by 13:00). Tracking number will be added to the shared Drive folder.
- LumenAV drop: Alex confirmed he will be on-site Thu 07:30 for patch and tech check; he requested all PDFs by Wed 07:00 PT to stage to local machines.
- Security flags: Anya Rosales and David Chu will be escorted — security badge type: "Executive Temp"; events@acmecorp.com to share names for badge printing by Tue 3pm.
- Rehearsal map: Wed 15:00–17:00 reserved; please ensure presenters have 10-minute windows for confidence-checks.

I'll update Ground_Transport_Roster.xlsx with courier/tracking and add a separate tab for VIP seat mapping.

Mateo
